text:
ana: Heads-up — noticing ~2% of inbound HubSpot leads hit empty-owner after enrichment lag during peak. Want a lightweight runbook to cut SLA misses. TL;DR: fallback owner + short-circuit enrichment wait + alerting.

devon: Do we have a reproducible sample? any lead IDs or times?

jordan: I dug logs for last 2 hours — webhook 503 -> retry loop. enrichment job waits up to 90s currently, which causes the assigner to bail with no owner. I can add a 10s soft timeout and fallback path.

ana: (typo: ana) +1. Ideal fallback = `marketing-inbound` shared queue? Need to confirm Salesforce create rule interactions.

devon: Agree fallback queue is fine. Also want metrics: pct assigned within 2m and within 5m. Can we emit counters to Datadog?

jordan: Yes — I’ll add dd.counter('lead.assign.latency_bucket') and a span tag on `lead_pipeline`. Also will tag `hs_webhook_retry` counts.

opsbot: lead-watch: detected 18 unassigned leads >5m in last 24h (peak window 14:00-15:00 UTC).

ana: ok plan sketch: 1) set enrichment soft timeout = 10s (fast path) 2) assign fallback owner `marketing-inbound` on timeout 3) emit assign latency metrics + alert 4) tweak round-robin to skip owners with `out=true` tag and add 30s jitter to reduce claim collisions 5) add a slack alert when >5 unassigned leads for 5m.

devon: On the SF side we should ensure the create rule doesn't overwrite owner when fallback is set. I'll run a mapping audit later today. @devon -> will check automations.

jordan: Pushing the small patch to a canary branch now. Snippet:
```json
{"enrichment": {"soft_timeout_ms": 10000, "fallback_owner": "marketing-inbound"}, "rr": {"jitter_s": 30, "skip_out_owners": true}}
```

lead-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled for 2026-06-12T03:20:00Z (pipeline #428).

ana: also want observability: add grafana panel and a simple runbook link. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/lead-routing (new panel: Assign latency p50/p95, unassigned_count).

devon: I'll add the SF rule checklist: verify Owner field is not auto-cleared by our flows, and test fallback owner visibility in Salesforce.

jordan: Quick note — the round-robin tweak needs a lightweight migration: owners table add `out_until_ts` and skip during pick. I can ship logic + migration in the same PR.

ana: rollout schedule: canary this afternoon -> monitor 1h -> if green, roll to prod. I'll post a short playbook in Confluence and pin to #marketing.

devon: Tests I want before prod: 1) simulated 503s on HS webhook 2) verify assign within 2m 3) SF mapping behaves (no overwrite).

jordan: Got it. I'll add unit tests + a chaos test in staging to simulate retry storms.

ana: Thanks team. Assignments: @jordan patch + tests, @devon SF mapping & qa, I'll own rollout/docs + dashboard. Ping here once canary is up. :thumbsup:

lead-bot: note: created follow-up ticket LEAD-814 in intake board for runbook + dashboard.
